request.what: Fund Dolos by TxPipe: Maintaining Cardano's Lightweight Data Node, Year 2.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 420,000 ADA plus a 105,000 ADA contingency reserve and a 15,750 ADA Intersect administration fee, totaling 540,750 ADA.

Dolos is a Rust-based lightweight Cardano data node that connects directly to the Cardano network, indexes ledger primitives, and exposes five query interfaces including Mini-Blockfrost, UTxO-RPC, Mini-Kupo, and an Ouroboros N2C Unix socket.
Dolos has 939 commits, 80 releases, 129 stars, 51 forks, and 27 contributors.
The maintainer will provide essential codebase maintenance, community support, and AI-friendly documentation and integration resources.
Dolos aligns with Intersect Strategic Pillar 2 focus area A.3 for Developer Experience and open-source maintenance incentives.
The proposal achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase.
The requested withdrawal does not, at submission, breach the 350M ADA Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713.
Audit, oversight, reporting obligations, and milestone-based disbursement controls will be provided through Intersect and technically capable third parties.
TxPipe has received funding through 30 Project Catalyst proposals from Funds 9 through 14, with 26 delivered and 4 under development and on schedule.
Treasury funds will be administered through Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts with stated TRSC and PSSC addresses, multisignature-style authorization thresholds, and an audit dashboard.

summary: The document requests 540,750 ADA to fund one year of Dolos maintenance by TxPipe through Intersect, emphasizing open-source infrastructure value, prior budget-process support, NCL compliance, and smart-contract-based oversight.
